m2-unresolved-shrinkage.title: Explicit resolved/unresolved status + effective_axis_sigma reuse + shrinkage evidence (TDD)
m2-unresolved-shrinkage.imperative: Extend driver_utility.py: status='resolved' iff n_sessions >= MIN_RESOLVED_SESSIONS(=3) else 'unresolved'. Compute a per-axis reference_value = population std of g_deficit for that axis across ALL valid rows in rows_df, floored to a small constant, and pass it into effective_axis_sigma(value=delta, sigma=sigma, status=status, reference_value=reference_value) (REUSED, not reimplemented) to produce effective_sigma. Add tests to test_driver_utility.py FIRST (red): (a) a thin (1-2 session) driver/axis gets status='unresolved' and effective_sigma widened to >= reference_value (the reserved scale) even though its raw delta could be near 0; (d) within that SAME thin group, seed one low-sigma (trustworthy) session and one high-sigma (noisy outlier) session and assert the pooled delta lies closer to the low-sigma session's value than the simple/raw mean of the group does (partial-pooling shrinkage toward the axis's own better-supported sessions, away from the noisy outlier's raw pull). Observe both failing, then implement to green.

preconditions.satisfied_by: m1 resolved-case pooling test green (2 passed)

postconditions.statement: TDD red: unresolved-status + shrinkage tests written and observed failing -- manual attest
postconditions.satisfied_by: TestUnresolvedReservedSigma + TestShrinkage written; observed genuine RED: test_thin_driver_unresolved_with_wide_effective_sigma FAILED (effective_sigma=0.01 == raw sigma, NOT widened) -- real bug found: effective_axis_sigma prioritizes value over reference_value whenever value is not None, so passing delta(~0) as value defeats the reserved-wide-sigma contract. Fixed by passing value=None for unresolved status so it falls through to reference_value.

postconditions.statement: unresolved status + widened effective_sigma + shrinkage tests green
